I think that's going to be enough to finally start the reversal later on and hopefully get a move like we got back in the previous cycle, rather than what we had over here. In this cycle we only had a move to the downside like this because again, bitcoin dominance did not really go down too much, when it went down it was in this area and then after that it started getting all time highs again, or at least cycle highs. Speaking of the bitcoin dominance chart, right now I'm still waiting for a drop here, but again a drop is most likely only going to happen because Bitcoin is going to drop more than the altcoins and more than Ethereum and that's what's gonna lead to ADA Bitcoin going up and obviously Ethereum Bitcoin also going up like we did for example back in this area in the previous bear market let's say in June of 2022, Bitcoin dominance went down 10% but during that time, the altcoins did not really do anything. like let's say these targets which is most likely even if we get to let's say these targets, which is most likely not going to happen but let's say bitcoin does start getting a drop right now, and As mentioned before, if it does not manage to find support at 3.3 cents or 2.8 cents. Then at worst that could get to 2.2 cents or even 1.6 cents. And the setup is going to turn exactly into what Cardano was when it was launched back in 2017 or let's say at the end of 2017. Other than that, the market situation is very boring, I'm still waiting for Bitcoin to break down, even though we got a reaction to this draw 0.618 support level right there, please understand that on the daily chart, we closed another week below the moving average on the RSI, and yes right now we are above it, but you know we did the exact same thing a couple of days ago, we got above it during the day and then by the end of the day, we closed back below it which gave us a movement to the downside downside that's exactly what happened back in that area before a huge drop so I'm not gonna, you know, be too surprised in case we get a move like that very soon and that move I expected to put us at $40 thousand or maybe between $50 thousand and $40 thousand and then after that we're probably gonna get a move to the upside and then later in the year I think bitcoin is going to get another move to the downside which might as well be the bear market low of October. If bitcoin breaks below $63,000 that's going to lead to a huge drop so definitely be careful. That's pretty much it, I hope you enjoyed. Like, subscribe and I will see you in the next one.
